description: Source code for QuicSimpleServerPacketWriter class implementing packet writing functionalities for a QUIC server, including methods for writing packets, handling write completion, and querying packet size and capabilities.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServerPacketWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for writing packets in a QUIC server context, managing socket communication, write status, and packet size queries.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServerPacketWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket and dispatcher references.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon write completion, updates write blocked status and notifies dispatcher.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Returns whether writing is currently blocked.

methods.name: SetWritable
methods.description: Sets the writer as writable, clearing blocked status.

methods.name: MessageTooBigErrorCode
methods.description: Returns error code indicating message size too big.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Attempts to write a packet to the socket, returning the result and handling errors.

methods.name: GetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of outgoing packets.

methods.name: SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Indicates whether release time support is available (returns false).

methods.name: IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates whether batch mode is supported (returns false).

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Provides the next buffer location for writing packets.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes any buffered data, returning a success result.
